title: Contemporary Media Discourse, Echo Chambers, and Deliberative Democracy

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: The digital transition has revolutionized and fragmented the public sphere. Algorithms optimize for emotional outrage, accelerating *polarizáció* and locking citizens into hermetic *véleménybuborékok* (echo chambers).

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Restoring *deliberatív demokrácia* requires reviving *az érvelési kultúra* (the culture of argumentation): replacing clickbait slogans with rational deliberation, evidence-based claims, and mutual listening.
